what_happened.line: The Select Board approved the revised PEC agreement, under which the mitigation fund is paid out as a one-time premium holiday and then exhausted.
The board voted to approve a BYOB license for Kebablicious and a Lions Club voluntary boot drive request.
The board authorized the town manager to complete a legislative priorities letter with an IT bond bill added.
Discussion of the school project peer review was held over to next week pending advice from town counsel.
Snow and ice expenses were reported to exceed the appropriation, with the reserve fund and free cash named as possible cover.

why_it_matters: Snow and ice spending above its appropriation would be covered from the reserve fund or free cash, which are town budget money, mostly taxes, and are then not available for other uses.
The PEC payout is a one-time premium holiday, so the fund is spent once and will not offset premiums in later years.
watch_next: Next week's agenda: a vote on the Boys and Girls Club week proclamation and the held-over school project peer review discussion.
A workshop between the board and the Park Commission, to be scheduled.
